learning_outcomes.text: Students expand their acquired knowledge in engineering education and subject didactics.
Students transfer their knowledge to didactic problems of designing educational and qualification processes.
Students assess the suitability of acquired knowledge for solving didactic problems.

Students know and use project management tools. They apply engineering education and subject didactic strategies and methods to analyze professional technical work and to design professional education and qualification processes in a problem-related way.
Students are able to penetrate complex problems in engineering education and develop solutions.
Students work in a team/group and self-organized within a given time to develop solutions or solution approaches. They present their work results.
Students reflect on the state of their didactic professionalization.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the task and definition of objectives from a subject area of engineering education
Creation of a project and milestone plan
Development and, if applicable, execution of possible solution concepts
Evaluation and reflection of selected solutions
